## Key Highlights & Callouts

::: {.callout-note}
## Data Coverage
The DfT count points cover major motorways and A-roads, while secondary and local roads rely heavily on spatial interpolation and network centrality metrics.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## Validation Strategy
Spatial leave-one-out cross-validation prevents spatial autocorrelation leak between training and testing sets.
:::
